summary.text: Gary Stevens, a Republican, is a member of the Alaska Senate for District C and is Senate President, according to the Alaska Legislature.

paragraphs.text: Stevens was elected to the Alaska House of Representatives in 2000 and took office in January 2001; two years later he was appointed to the Senate, where he has served since, including as Senate Majority Leader in 2005-2006.

A retired professor of history and humanities at the University of Alaska, Stevens previously served as mayor of the Kodiak Island Borough and of the City of Kodiak, according to his legislative biography.
His biography lists a B.A. from Linfield College and an M.F.A. and Ph.D. from the University of Oregon, and service in the U.S. Army as a first lieutenant.
